items.title: Apollo Global Management (APO) Adds Fintech Founder Meyer Malka To Board In 2027
items.summary: Apollo Global Management (NYSE: APO) appointed Meyer "Micky" Malka to its Board of Directors, effective January 2027. Malka is the founder and managing partner of Ribbit Capital, a venture firm focused on fintech and technology-driven financial services. His addition introduces a fintech-focused entrepreneur to Apollo's boardroom at a time of broad digital change across alternative asset managers. Malka's upcoming board role at Apollo fits into a wider shift toward tech-driven capital...
